subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella remain open until all Anthropic signed-thinking replay variants are resolved, or should maintainers formally make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 the canonical remaining prevention tracker now that the recovery carriers landed?
rationale: The recovery fixes are on main, but the prevention path intentionally changes provider replay semantics and overlaps multiple open issues and PRs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a maintainer-approved prevention PR lands or the cluster is deliberately split.

options.title: Promote Narrow Canonical
options.body: Close this issue only after posting a clear handoff to the narrower canonical remaining issue and preserving the recovery evidence links.

options.title: Backport Recovery Only
options.body: Treat the merged recovery fixes as the release-critical work and defer prevention policy to a later provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a maintainer-approved prevention PR lands or the cluster is deliberately split.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing candidate for the Anthropic replay-policy tradeoff from recent provider history and issue discussion.
